meta.title: Long Ký — A thousand years of Vietnamese history
meta.description: Long Ký is a history app for Vietnam: from the Hồng Bàng dawn to today, one chapter per era, one cited source per event. Free, no ads.

switchLangAria: Đọc trang này bằng tiếng Việt

hero.eyebrow: THE HISTORY OF VIETNAM, IN YOUR HAND
hero.lead: A thousand years of Vietnamese history. Read, explore and learn era by era, with every source in plain view.

final.title: Now, start from the beginning.
final.body: Long Ký opens at Hồng Bàng and walks forward to today. Free, no ads. If you like it, buy Long Ký a cup of tea.

final.support: Need help, or spotted a mistake?

footer.ai: Illustrations are made with AI assistance. Every page in the app names its sources.
